question_text: Explain how transaction isolation can prevent two clients from both confirming the last available seat.
adaptation_rationale: Isolation and reliable transactions explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: The availability check and reservation update form a transaction; conflicting transactions are serialized or blocked/aborted. The second must recheck after the first commits and cannot confirm an already-booked seat.

marking_points.criterion: First successful booking changes seat state before second confirmation.
Second transaction rechecks/fails rather than double books.
